title: Opportunity of Being Heard by Central Authority

content.scenario: A company is under investigation by the Central Authority for allegedly engaging in unfair trade practices. The Central Authority is considering passing an order against the company.
content.outcome: The Central Authority shall give the company an opportunity of being heard before passing any order, ensuring the company can present its case.

user_queries: What rights do companies have during Central Authority investigations?
Can the Central Authority pass orders without hearing the company?
How does the Central Authority ensure fairness in its investigations?
